title: Binary restriction via reindexed coordinates
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the sign cube on $n$ coordinates to the signs, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and fix signs outside $J$. For every binary input on the full coordinate set, evaluating the resulting restricted function is the same as converting its coordinates in $J$ to signs, reindexing them by their positions in $J$, and evaluating the corresponding reindexed restriction of $f$.
